qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Closed-loop Mako robotic surgery ecosystem ($1M+ capital install) creates insurmountable switching costs for orthopedic surgeons and hospitals, locking in exclusive pull-through of Stryker joint implants with >95% retention. In MedSurg, proprietary razor-and-blade consumables (Neptune fluid waste cartridges, Sage hygiene, 1788 camera systems) provide recurring high-margin cash flows. Strong pricing power demonstrated by +1.0-1.5% positive net price realization across inflationary cycles. Erosion threats include competing robotic platforms (Zimmer ROSA, J&J Velys) and potential hospital capital spending deceleration.
qualitative.note: Best-in-class medtech compounder dominating orthopedic robotics and specialized hospital equipment. High switching costs anchored by the closed-loop Mako robotic ecosystem (>1.5M procedures, >95% pull-through implant retention) and indispensable MedSurg consumable franchises (Neptune, Sage, 1788 visualization). Multi-decade tailwinds from demographic aging and hospital automation insulate against macro risks. Robust balance sheet with net debt amortizable in <3.5 years of Owner Earnings and 8.0x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: procedure & robotic volume 6.0% + pricing & premium mix 1.5% + tuck-in reinvestment 1.5% + net buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial operating history demonstrates exceptional compounding: revenue expanded from $11.3B in FY2016 to $25.1B in FY2025 (11.2% CAGR), driven by organic growth >10% and high-synergy tuck-in acquisitions (Wright Medical, Vocera, Inari Medical). Tangible/Operating ROIC consistently exceeds 35-50% (FY2025: 40.8%), while reported GAAP ROIC is 11.3% due to $25B in accumulated acquisition goodwill and intangibles. Free cash flow conversion is superior at 106.6% of GAAP Net Income over 5 years (FY2025 Owner FCF of $4.04B vs NI of $3.25B), reflecting light capex requirements (~3% of sales). Positive pricing realization (+1.0-1.5%) achieved counter to industry deflationary trends due to differentiated robotic clinical outcomes and proprietary consumables. Solid balance sheet: Net Debt of $10.85B is 2.68x Owner FCF and 3.34x Net Income, supported by $4.01B cash and strong EBIT interest coverage of 8.05x ($4.89B EBIT vs $607M interest).
